Your Rights (ARCO)

With your permission, AuricRX MedCoach will read steps and sleep data from Health Connect (which may come from Samsung Health, Fitbit, Garmin, Mi Fitness, or other apps). We use this data only to show you your history and charts within the app. We do not diagnose. We do not sell this data, use it for advertising, or share it with third parties. It stays on your phone and is not sent to our servers. You can revoke this permission anytime in Settings > Privacy or in Health Connect, and delete imported data.
